info.name: Snack Counter Automation (Oslo + Bengaluru)
info.description:
Every API of the snack counter, in demo order: **A** Oslo (NOK), **B** Bengaluru (INR), **C** a visitor from India refilling Oslo, **D** budget limits, **E** HR rejecting, **F** the monthly report in NOK, **G** explore and errors.

1. Start the app: `mvn spring-boot:run` (port 8085). Start fresh for the expected names and totals.
2. Run the requests top to bottom (or the whole collection with Postman's Runner).
3. Each request has checks (Test Results tab) and saves the refill/claim ids it gets, so you never type ids.

Change `baseUrl` under the collection's Variables if the app runs elsewhere. Swagger UI: http://localhost:8085/swagger-ui.html

item.name: 0. Start here
item.description: Start the app (`mvn spring-boot:run`, port 8085). For the names and amounts in the checks to match, start from a **fresh app** (storage is in memory). Refill and claim ids are captured automatically, so you never type them.

F. Monthly report: both offices, one total in NOK
item.description: Simulated rate: 1 INR = 0.12 NOK. On a fresh run: Oslo 6 150 NOK, Bengaluru 2 500 INR (300 NOK), total 6 450 NOK.

item.name: F1. Monthly report (current month)

exec: pm.test("Both offices, each in its own currency", () => { const c = Object.fromEntries(body.offices.map(o => [o.office, o.spent.currency])); pm.expect(c).to.eql({OSLO: 'NOK', BENGALURU: 'INR'}); });

pm.test("Total = sum of both offices in NOK", () => { const sum = body.offices.reduce((s, o) => s + o.spentInReportCurrency.amount, 0); pm.expect(body.totalSpent.amount).to.be.closeTo(sum, 0.001); });

pm.test("Fresh run: Oslo 6150 NOK, Bengaluru 2500 INR, total 6450 NOK", () => { const o = Object.fromEntries(body.offices.map(x => [x.office, x.spent.amount])); pm.expect([o.OSLO, o.BENGALURU, body.totalSpent.amount]).to.eql([6150, 2500, 6450]); });

request.description: Also shows budget left per office, money still owed to volunteers, and the top items.

exec: pm.test("History tells the story", () => { pm.expect(body.history.map(e => e.text).join(' | ')).to.include('handed off'); });

item.name: G3. Every chat message the system sent

exec: pm.test("Both offices' channels were used", () => { const to = body.map(m => m.to); pm.expect(to).to.include('#snacks-oslo'); pm.expect(to).to.include('#snacks-bengaluru'); });

item.name: G4. Every claim HR received

exec: pm.test("In order HR-1, HR-2, ...", () => { const n = body.map(c => Number(c.claimId.slice(3))); pm.expect(n).to.eql([...n].sort((a, b) => a - b)); });
